repeated_test_expectations.expectation: Exercise every declared operation through actual service registration and independently read its result.
Crash/restart and lost-response recovery retains durable intent and does not duplicate effects.
Wrong owner/account/device/grant and expired/revoked context refuse; logs and projections redact secrets.
Producer-to-consumer contract works against complete dependent services and admitted provider sandbox; no stub at certification.
Named test rejects a violating plan or evidence set; independently verified per referenced unit.
